name: Wanted: ORCS!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
By order of Corporal Noreg Stormpike, all able bodied soldiers of Stormpike are required to slay any opposing orcs that they meet upon the field of battle.

Soldiers are required to remove a tusk or tooth from the maw of the enemy and present said tooth as proof of their accomplishment.

Wear protective gloves.
narrative.objectives:
You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley.

Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

objectiveItems.name: Orc Tooth
sources: Frostwolf in Alterac Valley and 4 more
